subject: revenuesystem.ui.interactive_foundation
summary: Owner requires Windows and Android screens to be designed on an interactive architectural foundation from inception, rather than retrofitting movement onto static screens.

required: State-driven components with explicit events, actions and data binding
Purposeful in-element motion designed together with workflow and visual identity
Working representative screen on real Windows and Android devices before expanding implementation
Preserve approved artistic and visual direction
Research suitable maintained open-source components and specialist evidence before custom implementation
details.prohibited_approach: Static screen or slideshow first, then decorative animation retrofit.
details.technical_interpretation: Interactive foundation is a component/state/event architecture requirement, not proof that a particular framework is required or that WPF/MAUI cannot support it.
details.acceptance: Demonstrate input, data changes, commands, loading, confirmed save, errors and conflicts in functional components; transitions and screenshots alone do not establish compliance.
details.implementation_status: Requirement recorded; no implementation or framework approval claimed.

source.ref: Owner explicitly requires interactive screen foundations instead of retrofitted static screens
